title: How the Japanese Spy Drama ‘Vivant’ Became The Target of China’s Anger
summary_full: “Vivant,” a Japanese thriller that features Chinese spies, has drawn intense criticism from Beijing. Its creators defend the show, saying it is “completely fictional.”
